title_en: Amendment (XII) to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
1. One paragraph is added as paragraph 2 to Article 165 of the Criminal Law, and that Article is amended to read: "Where a director, supervisor, or senior officer of a State-owned company or enterprise, by taking advantage of his position, operates for himself or for another person a business that is of the same type as that of the company or enterprise in which he holds a position, thereby obtaining illegal benefits, if the amount is huge, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the amount is especially huge, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined.
"Where a director, supervisor, or senior officer of another company or enterprise, in violation of laws or administrative regulations, commits the act prescribed in the preceding paragraph, thereby causing significant losses to the interests of the company or enterprise, he shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

3. One paragraph is added as paragraph 2 to Article 169 of the Criminal Law, and that Article is amended to read: "Where a person who is directly in charge of a State-owned company, enterprise, or its superior competent department, engaging in malpractices for personal gain, converts State-owned assets into shares at a low price or sells them at a low price, thereby causing significant losses to the interests of the State, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if he causes especially significant losses to the interests of the State, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years.
"Where a person who is directly in charge of another company or enterprise, engaging in malpractices for personal gain, converts the assets of the company or enterprise into shares at a low price or sells them at a low price, thereby causing significant losses to the interests of the company or enterprise, he shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph."

4. Paragraph 1 of Article 387 of the Criminal Law is amended to read: "Where a State organ, State-owned company, enterprise, institution, or people's organization extorts or illegally accepts property from another person and seeks benefits for that person, if the circumstances are serious, the unit shall be fined, and the persons who are directly in charge and other persons who are directly responsible shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are especially serious, they shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years."

6. Paragraph 1 of Article 391 of the Criminal Law is amended to read: "Any person who, for the purpose of seeking illegitimate benefits, gives property to a State organ, State-owned company, enterprise, institution, or people's organization, or in economic activities, in violation of State regulations, gives a kickback or service charge under any name, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years and shall also be fined."

7. Article 393 of the Criminal Law is amended to read: "Where a unit, for the purpose of seeking illegitimate benefits, offers bribes, or in violation of State regulations, gives a kickback or service charge to a functionary of a State organ, if the circumstances are serious, the unit shall be fined, and the persons who are directly in charge and other persons who are directly responsible shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are especially serious, they shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years and shall also be fined. If the illegal gains obtained by bribery belong to an individual, the individual shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Articles 389 and 390 of this Law."
8. This Amendment shall come into force on March 1, 2024.
